title: parseLog tolerates blank lines and comment lines
prompt: Update src/eval/metrics.mjs parseLog() to silently skip blank lines and lines starting with '#' (comments). Add unit tests for both cases using inline fixture strings.
acceptanceCriteria: parseLog returns no event for a blank line
parseLog returns no event for a line starting with '#'
parseLog still returns correct events for valid lines interleaved with blanks and comments
unit test covers all three cases
